From: Alice Tran <alice.tran@stellus.com>

Cc: security@stellus.com
Date: 2027-11-14T08:15:00-05:00
Subject: Request: Key handshake artifacts & operator ACL snapshot

Hi Rishi —

Our SOC 2 auditor has asked us to collect a small set of artifacts about tenant key handling for the environment you host for Stellus. Can you please provide the following items by end of next week (Nov 21)?

- A short runbook or checklist that describes your key rotation/handshake procedure for customer BYOK and tenant-managed keys (prefer PDF).
- An operator ACL export (current snapshot) showing roles with HSM/KMS privileges. CSV is fine.
- A short sample of HSM shift logs (redacted is ok) showing a recent rotation + operator approvals.
- Confirmation of encryption-in-transit controls for key transport (TLS ciphers, mutual TLS if used).

If there are any access controls or a documented retention policy for rotation logs, include that too. We can accept files via an S3 presigned link or secure transfer. Let me know an expected delivery date and whether you need an NDA or transfer form.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Tran
Security Program Manager | Stellus Financial
alice.tran@stellus.com

--
This request is scoped to the tenant indicated in the attached SOC scope.
